segments.label: PAPER
segments.headline: What frontier models still can't do

beats.narration: This robot is run by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier AI model. Why can't it plug this in?
direct: This robot is run by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier AI model. Why can't it plug this in?

beats.narration: A team led by SenseNova tested it on eight real robots, in a report from earlier in October.
direct: A team led by SenseNova tested it on eight real robots, in a report from earlier in October.

beats.narration: In simulation, it scored ninety-nine to one hundred percent on six benchmark suites,
direct: In simulation, it scored ninety-nine to one hundred percent on six benchmark suites,

beats.narration: but with help: it could learn from each benchmark's training set.
direct: but with help: it could learn from each benchmark's training set.

beats.narration: On real robots, pick-and-place worked seventeen of eighteen times. Plug insertion: zero for eleven.
direct: On real robots, pick-and-place worked seventeen of eighteen times. Plug insertion: zero for eleven.

beats.narration: Why? The report says the task sets the limit. Precise contact, like a plug, stays markedly harder.
direct: Why? The report says the task sets the limit. Precise contact, like a plug, stays markedly harder.

beats.narration: Its verdict: competent, but not yet practical. And it's a preprint, with small trial counts.
direct: Its verdict: competent, but not yet practical. And it's a preprint, with small trial counts.

beats.narration: Two new papers try to close that gap: this week's full episode. Link below.
